name: Savepoint the Silver Cat
blurb: Savepoint, a smoky silver-grey cat with a white muzzle and bib, naps on the same warm stone daily so he never loses his place.

name: Joypad the Mitten Cat
blurb: Joypad, a pale silver cat with four snow-white mitten paws and a white chest, bats a pinecone along the garden path for hours.

name: Highscore the Grey Cat
blurb: Highscore, a grey-and-white cat with a white chin and dark grey brow marks, hops stone to stone to beat yesterday's best run.
